description: Rewritten tool_description_safety enrichment that achieves 20+ distinct scores. Current version has only 3 distinct values. Must read MULTIPLE metadata fields: description_length, param_count, return_doc_present, example_count, has_deprecation_notice, schema_complexity_score. Weight these features with finer granularity using additive scoring bands (<50 chars = 0, 50-200 = 5, etc.) and small increments per param documented (2 points each). Add subtle scoring for schema validation presence. Pure function compute_score(metadata). Must pass enrichment_harness.py with 20+ distinct score threshold.
